input.title: Unbestimmte Leistungsbegrenzung bei Längskreuzung
input.message: The description 'wie vor, jedoch Längskreuzung Drainageleitung' (as before, however longitudinal crossing drainage line) lacks specific technical details. It does not specify the diameter of the drainage line, the required separation distance, or the specific protection measures (e.g., concrete encasement, sand bedding) required for the crossing. This ambiguity violates the requirement for clear and exhaustive descriptions under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 and may lead to disputes regarding the scope of work and necessary protective measures.
input.reference: VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1; VOB/C DIN 18316 (if applicable for PE pipes)
input.suggestion: Specify the diameter of the drainage line, the minimum separation distance, and the required protection measures (e.g., 'with 100mm sand bedding and concrete encasement').
